import numpy as np
def equation(t,P,params):
    a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,w,k=params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7],params[8],params[9]
    s=np.sin(w*t); co=np.cos(w*t)
    return a + b*t + c*P + d*P**2 + e/P + f*t/P + (g*s + h*co)/P + k*t*s/P + (k*0.5)*t*co/P + 0.0*P
